#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int calculate_average (int n, vector<int> &array){
    int sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        sum += array[i];
    }
    return sum/n;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    
    vector<int> years(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++){
        cin >> years[i];
    }
    
    cout << calculate_average(n, years) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
